versions.content: In addition to the standard error detection described in chapter 7.4, on a call to Csm_SaveContextJob() or Csm_RestoreContextJob() the CSM shall check if the related job is currently active. If so, the operation shall continue as specified. Otherwise (the job is in IDLE state), the function shall immediately return with E_NOT_OK.
